reviews.title: Lost access
reviews.text: The app was really easy to use and I loved how ads weren’t shoved in your face 24/7. However, I have one critique. There’s no “forgot password” button, let alone any way to get access back to the app if you forget it. I unfortunately forgot my password, and I was forced to delete and reinstall the app entirely. The security question wouldn’t pop up for me either. I lost months of hard work and important information. 3 stars for me.

reviews.title: Problem with lock

Over time we stopped using it and it automatically uninstalled from my iPad. Today we were reminding a plan we had made on my app and tried opening it and the password lock showed up. We tried many attempts but we have forgotten our password. It was very important and memorable plans and things we had written in the diary. Since tjis app is backed up my iCloud, is there any way to recover the stuff we have written beyond the lock or maybe there could be a possibility of resetting the pattern lock with preserving the iCloud synced data. Please help!!

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text:
The recent update seems to get rid of how I layout my entries. When writing I like to double space after my paragraphs but when I save the entry it merges it into a full single paragraph. I tried putting breaks of my own to keep paragraphs separated but it just wont save any spaces more than doubled spaced.


Edit: It took a few days since I reviewed. New update improved the situation! The team of the app is amazing and did great at feedback! Thank you all!

reviews.title: Not too bad . . . mostly.
reviews.text:
This app has changed a lot since the last time I've seen it. What hasn't changed is the weird slogan on the home screen. "A Diary Mean Yes Indeed"—something tells me that there was a funky translation involved!

Anyway, there is now a free drawing tool and tags. (I don't know why tags were necessary.) It's frustrating that some things (most of the stickers and themes, almost all of the backgrounds, and the stats) require a subscription/one-time payment, but I'm no longer in the "This is so stupid!" camp because it isn't actually. (Well, the $50 one-time payment is definitely too far.) What IS stupid is that FORMATTING is a paid-only feature, and is limited even then.
But then again, at least the lock feature isn't paid-only. BEAR!!!
